name: Midjourney
summary: AI image and video generation known for artistic quality.
description: Midjourney generates highly aesthetic images, and now short videos, from text prompts via its web app and Discord. It is known for its distinctive artistic style and strong community. There is no free trial on midjourney.com; plans are Basic $10/month, Standard $30/month (with unlimited Relax mode), Pro $60/month and Mega $120/month, with discounts for annual billing.

pricing.label: Premium
pricing.note: There is no free trial on midjourney.com; plans are Basic $10/month, Standard $30/month (with unlimited Relax mode), Pro $60/month and Mega $120/month, with discounts for annual billing.

features: Text-to-Image Generation: Creates detailed and artistic images from natural language prompts.
Style Customization: Supports a wide range of artistic styles and visual effects.
Community Gallery: Users can explore and remix public creations.
Iterative Prompting: Refine and upscale images through multiple prompt variations.

howToUse.title: Join Midjourney on Discord
howToUse.description: Access Midjourney by joining the Discord server.

howToUse.title: Enter Text Prompts
howToUse.description: Use the /imagine command to create images from text.

howToUse.title: Refine & Upscale
howToUse.description: Iteratively adjust prompts and upscale images as needed.

howToUse.title: Download or Remix
howToUse.description: Download final images or remix public artworks.
